idx_notification_delivery_retry.name: idx_notification_delivery_retry
idx_notification_delivery_retry.where: ((status = ANY (ARRAY['sent'::notification_status, 'failed'::notification_status])) AND (retry_count < 3) AND (next_retry_at IS NOT NULL))

meeting_update.name: meeting_update
meeting_update.using: ((town_id = get_current_town_id()) AND (is_admin() OR has_board_permission('A1'::text, board_id) OR has_board_permission('M1'::text, board_id)))

Authenticated users can update addenda f.name: Authenticated users can update addenda for their town
Authenticated users can update addenda f.using:
(town_id IN ( SELECT ua.town_id
   FROM user_account ua
  WHERE (ua.id = auth.uid())))

town_members_update_invitations.name: town_members_update_invitations
town_members_update_invitations.using:
(town_id IN ( SELECT user_account.town_id
   FROM user_account
  WHERE (user_account.auth_user_id = auth.uid())))
